title: Declare, assign, don't shadow
hints: := declares new variables, and = assigns to existing ones. Named result parameters already exist when the function body starts, and Go rejects variables that are declared but never used.
Read each compiler error: "no new variables on left side of :=" and "declared and not used" each point to a specific line.
Use = for count and for longest inside the loop. An inner `longest := item` creates a new variable that disappears at the closing brace (shadowing). Remove the unused variable entirely.
